description.value:
Trigger the first exchange of attacks against a chosen foe each encounter

Duration rest of the encounter

Effect +3 circumstance bonus to your next attack roll against that foe and to Acrobatics/Athletics checks to control positioning against them

Winning the first clash sets footing, range, and tempo on your terms.

cinderfall.incomplete: +3 circumstance to the next attack roll against a chosen foe, and to Acrobatics/Athletics against them for positioning, for the rest of the encounter. This class's own target:mark:<slug>-style dynamic-target predicate idiom is confirmed unfireable anywhere in this corpus -- there is no working way to scope a bonus to "that one foe" dynamically chosen at trigger time.
